rules: Use Playfair Display for all major headings to achieve a distinctive, premium Indian real estate editorial look. Install via @fontsource/playfair-display.
Use Manrope for body text, form inputs, and small metrics for clean readability. Install via @fontsource/manrope.
Employ tight tracking (tracking-tight) on large serif headings.
Numbered manifesto chapters should use massive, low-opacity serif numerals (e.g., text-[15vw] text-forest/5) overlaid in the background.

background.description: Warm ivory / stone paper texture for an earthy, premium feel.

text.description: Rich charcoal ink for maximum readability but softer than pure black.

accent.description: Deep forest/emerald as the grounding brand color, Brass/Gold for CTAs and highlights.

forbidden: #FFFFFF (use #FCFBF9 instead where absolute white is needed)

visual_enhancers.textures: Apply a subtle SVG noise filter or background image with very low opacity to simulate warm stone or paper texture.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use fine 1px borders in #C5A059 (Brass/Gold) or #0B2B26/20 (Forest with low opacity) to frame content.
visual_enhancers.shapes: Use clipped frames (sharp corners combined with smooth rounded corners, e.g., rounded-tr-3xl rounded-bl-3xl) to display images like editorial spotlight cuts.

motion.philosophy: Tasteful and cheap. Premium purposeful motion via Framer Motion but constrained for fast load and mobile-first performance.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal on load. Wrap text lines in overflow-hidden, animate y from 100% to 0.
motion.scroll_effects: Use lenis for smooth scroll. Use simple opacity + translateY (y: 20 -> y: 0) for section reveals.
motion.reduced_motion: Ensure all framer-motion animations respect prefers-reduced-motion.

layouts.hero: Large kinetic hero, split layout or full-screen with overlaid text. Image should have a slight vignette or clipped frame. Must include Project Name (Manthan Legacy), Location (Vatva, Ahmedabad), Starting Price ('Price on Request'), and DOWNLOAD BROCHURE CTA.
layouts.quick_facts: A horizontal strip or bento-grid detailing 7 towers, 2 & 3 BHK homes, 133 retail shops, 1 Lac+ sq.ft open spaces, 70% open area, RERA: MAA15874. Use clean dividers.
layouts.amenities: Editorial bento grid or list with spotlight imagery. Numbered sections. Features: clubhouse, gym, temple, jogging track, 24x7 security, children's play area.
layouts.sticky_cta: On mobile (below md breakpoint), a fixed bottom bar with solid Deep Forest background and Brass text/icon for one-tap call/WhatsApp.

components.lead_form_modal: Shadcn Dialog. Minimalist ivory background. Fields: Name, Phone (with OTP verify UI implied), 4 qualifying questions. Submit button styled as solid deep forest.
components.thank_you_state: After form submission, replace dialog content with Thank You message and two massive CTAs: CALL NOW (tel:+917001660016) and CHAT ON WHATSAPP (wa.me/917001660016).
components.marquee: One slow editorial marquee using react-fast-marquee. Text: 'MANTHAN LEGACY — A PREMIUM RESIDENTIAL PROJECT IN VATVA, AHMEDABAD'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure brass text on ivory meets 4.5:1, use forest green for text if brass is too light.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs) must have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='download-brochure-btn').

image_urls.description: Modern premium residential building exterior to serve as hero background.
Landscaped park with fountain, representing the 1 Lac+ sq.ft open spaces.

3d_libraries.recommendation: None. The requirement prioritizes fast load and minimal animations. Use Framer Motion for simple scroll reveals and Lenis for smooth scroll, avoiding heavy WebGL/Canvas to ensure high mobile conversion.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, lenis (or @studio-freight/lenis), react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, @fontsource/playfair-display, @fontsource/manrope.
Configure tailwind.config.js to include the custom colors (ivory, forest, brass) and fonts.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Opt for asymmetrical, bento grids, and overlapping elements.
For the hero section, use `overflow-hidden` around text lines and animate them up for the line-by-line reveal.
Create a fixed sticky footer for mobile containing 'Call Now' and 'WhatsApp' buttons to drive conversions.
Use Shadcn UI for the Lead Form Dialog, customizing it heavily with the ivory and forest green palette.
Ensure 'DOWNLOAD BROCHURE' CTA triggers the lead form modal.
Implement the Thank You view inside the modal (or replacing the form content) after form submission with massive CTAs.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles, relevant to the app style (e.g., sharp corners or slightly rounded).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Use the provided image URLs exclusively. Never use placeholder text for images.
